header.title: RipZone
header.description: A scratch-off cover, like a lottery card, over the child. The cover is painted on a `canvas` and each stroke erases a soft-edged circle. When the scratched area reaches `threshold`, the cover fades out and the content is free. `variant` sets the look (`matte`, `foil`, `grit`) and `trigger` how it's scratched (`drag`, `click` or `always`). It doesn't use Particles: `rip-zone.css` is enough.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and scratch the card. Use "Refill" to cover the content again (changes `resetKey`).
playground.label: Prize!

base.title: Basic scratch
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="foil"`, `trigger="drag"`, `intensity="md"`) the cover hides the card and dragging erases a stroke with a `28` px radius. Once `62%` is scratched, the cover fades out in `480` ms and stops capturing the pointer. With the keyboard, Tab to the card and press Enter or Space to reveal it at once.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `matte` is a flat color. `foil` adds a diagonal metallic sheen. `grit` adds a grainy texture, like lottery tickets. All three use the same base color.

image.title: Over an image
image.description: The cover hides any content, like an image. The zone takes the child's size and the `canvas` matches it (with `devicePixelRatio` up to `2`). If the zone changes size after you start scratching (for example when the window shrinks), the scratched area is kept and scaled to the new size; only an untouched cover is repainted.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `drag` scratches while you drag. `click` erases one circle per click (here with `radius={36}`). `always` scratches by itself, in a zigzag, until it reaches `threshold`; here it starts after `delay={600}`. Its speed follows elapsed time, not frames, so it takes the same time on a 60 Hz and a 144 Hz screen.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `color` is the cover color. It accepts any CSS color, including variables: it's resolved once when painting. Without `color`, it uses a dark mix of `neutral-950` and `primary-800`. Prefer tokens.

radius.title: Brush radius
radius.description: `radius` is the brush radius in pixels (minimum `4`). It takes priority over `intensity`.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: `threshold` is the fraction of the cover to scratch before it finishes, from `0` to `1`. Each label shows the progress reported by `onProgress`, which updates in `1%` steps.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long the cover takes to fade once the threshold is reached. These use `threshold={0.3}` so it shows quickly. `delay` delays that fade and the start of `always`.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Without `radius`, `intensity` sets the brush size: `18`, `28` or `42` px. It also accepts a number from `0` to `1`. Scratch each card.

reset.title: Refill and progress
reset.description: Changing `resetKey` repaints the whole cover. `onProgress` reports the scratched fraction and `onComplete` fires once when the threshold is reached.

asChild.title: On an element (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the cover mounts directly on the child (an `article` here), without adding a `div`. The child gets `position: relative` from the surface class. With a void element like `img` or `input`, which can't hold the cover, it falls back to the wrapping `div`. If the child isn't focusable (like this `article`), while covered it becomes the reveal control: it gets `tabIndex`, `role="button"` and a default `aria-label`, so Tab and Enter or Space reveal it at once.

state.title: Pause and disabled
state.description: With `trigger="always"`, `isPaused` stops the auto-scrape, and if the cover is already fading (`1600` ms here), it freezes it halfway until unpaused. `isDisabled` prevents scratching: the cover keeps hiding the content and still blocks the pointer.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onScratchStart` fires on the first stroke (with the position). `onRipZone` when scratching starts and `outRipZone` when it ends, with the reason in `event.reason` (`drag` is reported as `hold`). `onComplete` arrives when the threshold is passed. While covered, the content is `inert`: the button can't be activated by pointer or by Tab. With the keyboard, focus the zone and press Enter to reveal it.

texts.body: Scratch the card to free the button.

header.title: RipZone API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `RipZone`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/rip-zone` with `rip-zone.css`, or from the package root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color and onProgress) and passes them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp and onPointerCancel run before the effect's internal logic. onClick and onKeyDown also run before the keyboard logic. tabIndex, role and aria-label override the values the effect sets when the root is the reveal control. ref is merged with the internal ref that measures the root. --gemfx-rip-zone-progress is written after style; -duration and -delay only when you pass duration or delay.

items.control: The effect is the control: the cover captures the pointer until it completes. With drag and click, the root sets user-select: none and touch-action: none.
items.hidden: The cover is decorative (aria-hidden). In wrapper mode, while covered, the surface is inert: the content leaves the Tab order and the accessibility tree until revealed. With asChild there's no separate surface and the content stays accessible. With isDisabled or isActive={false} it stops being inert. The content is in the DOM: don't use it to hide sensitive information.
items.keyboard: There's no keyboard scratch gesture: Enter or Space reveal everything at once and fire onComplete. In wrapper mode with drag or click, while covered, the root is the control: tabIndex=0, role="button" and aria-label="Reveal hidden content" unless you pass your own. With asChild the same happens if the child isn't focusable (article, div); a native control (button, a) or a child with its own tabIndex or role is left as is.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the fade is instant and always reveals the content at once. With drag and click you still scratch by hand.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the motion. Use it only when essential.
items.touch: With drag, touch users can't scroll starting from the effect. disabledOnTouch ignores touches and restores touch-action: auto; mouse and pen still work.

items.root: Root. `inline-flex`, `position: relative`, `isolation: isolate` and `overflow: hidden`. Sets the variable defaults.
items.variant: Active variant. The look is painted on the `canvas`, so the class changes nothing by itself.
items.trigger: Active trigger. Not added with `isDisabled` or `isActive={false}`. `drag` and `click` block selection and touch scrolling.
items.holding: Added while you drag. Switches the cursor to `grabbing`.
items.complete: Added when the threshold is reached. Fades the `canvas` (`opacity: 0`) and the layer stops capturing the pointer.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. The CSS doesn't use it: the fade is frozen from JS, pinning the `canvas`'s current `opacity` inline until unpaused.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 0`, `flex: 1 1 auto`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.
items.layer: Effect layer (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0`, `z-index: 1`, `border-radius: inherit`, `aria-hidden`). Captures the pointer until completion.
items.canvas: The `canvas` where the cover is painted. Has `cursor: grab` and the fade's `opacity` transition. Its size is written inline in pixels.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `--gemfx-rip-zone-progress` is written inline on every render: it's live state, only for reading. `-duration` and `-delay` go inline only when you pass the prop; otherwise you can set them from a class. Color and brush are resolved in JS from `color` and `radius`, so they have no variable.

items.progress: Scratched fraction, from `0` to `1`, updated in `1%` steps. Stops changing at the threshold. Children inherit it and can use it in `calc()`.
items.timing: Duration and delay of the `canvas` `opacity` transition. From CSS they only change the fade: the `always` start uses the `delay` prop.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables RipZone reads as defaults.

items.cover: Cover mix when you don't pass `color` (fallbacks `#111316` and `#085246`). Resolved in JS when painting.
items.durationBase: Default of `--gemfx-rip-zone-duration` in the CSS (fallback `480ms`). Overridden by the inline value when you pass `duration`.

content.title: Content
content.description: What sits under the cover and where the effect mounts.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: How it's scratched, refilled, paused and turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. With void elements like `img` or `input`, it falls back to the wrapping `div`.
items.variant: `matte` is a flat color, `foil` adds a metallic sheen and `grit` a grainy texture.
items.color: Cover color. Defaults to a dark mix of `neutral-950` and `primary-800`. Prefer tokens.
items.radius: Brush radius in pixels (minimum `4`). Takes priority over `intensity`.
items.threshold: Scratched fraction (`0` to `1`) after which the cover fades out.
items.duration: How long the cover takes to fade on completion.
items.delay: Delay of the fade and of the `always` start.
items.trigger: `drag` scratches while dragging, `click` erases one circle per click and `always` scratches by itself.
items.resetKey: Change this value to repaint the whole cover.
items.isActive: Allows scratching. When `false` the cover stays as is and keeps hiding the content.
items.isPaused: Stops the auto-scrape, blocks scratching and keyboard reveal, and freezes the fade where it is.
items.isDisabled: Blocks scratching. The cover keeps hiding the content.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the auto-scrape and the fade even if the user prefers less motion. Only when essential.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores the touch pointer; mouse and pen still work.
items.onScratchStart: Fires on the first stroke of the current cover, with the position (`x`, `y`) and progress.
items.onProgress: Fires when the scratched fraction changes (in `1%` steps).
items.onRipZone: Fires when scratching starts (first stroke, first click or `always` start).
items.outRipZone: Fires when the cover completes, or on disable, refill or unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. `--gemfx-rip-zone-progress` is written after; `-duration` and `-delay` only when you pass the prop.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
